## 작업 파일들 (패키지: com.cowave.search.repository.cache.tiered)

### 1. build.gradle.kts 수정
기존 dependencies에 Caffeine과 jackson-module-kotlin 추가:
```kotlin
dependencies {
    implementation("org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-starter-data-redis")
    implementation("com.github.ben-manes.caffeine:caffeine:3.1.8")
    implementation("com.fasterxml.jackson.module:jackson-module-kotlin")
    implementation(project(":shared"))
}
```

### 2. TieredCache.kt — 제네릭 캐시 인터페이스
```kotlin
package com.cowave.search.repository.cache.tiered

interface TieredCache<ID : Any, V : Any> {
    fun getOrFetch(ids: List<ID>, fetcher: (List<ID>) -> List<V>): List<V>
}
```

### 3. CacheSerializer.kt — 직렬화 인터페이스
```kotlin
package com.cowave.search.repository.cache.tiered

interface CacheSerializer<V : Any> {
    fun serialize(value: V): String
    fun deserialize(json: String): V
}
```

### 4. JacksonCacheSerializer.kt — Jackson 기반 JSON 직렬화 구현
```kotlin
package com.cowave.search.repository.cache.tiered

import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper

class JacksonCacheSerializer<V : Any>(
    private val objectMapper: ObjectMapper,
    private val type: Class<V>,
) : CacheSerializer<V> {
    override fun serialize(value: V): String = objectMapper.writeValueAsString(value)
    override fun deserialize(json: String): V = objectMapper.readValue(json, type)
}
```

### 5. CaffeineLocalCache.kt — L1 Caffeine 로컬 캐시
```kotlin
package com.cowave.search.repository.cache.tiered

import com.github.benmanes.caffeine.cache.Cache
import com.github.benmanes.caffeine.cache.Caffeine
import java.time.Duration

class CaffeineLocalCache<ID : Any, V : Any>(
    ttl: Duration,
    maxSize: Long,
) {
    private val cache: Cache<ID, V> = Caffeine.newBuilder()
        .expireAfterWrite(ttl)
        .maximumSize(maxSize)
        .build()

    fun getAll(ids: List<ID>): Map<ID, V> = ids.mapNotNull { id -> cache.getIfPresent(id)?.let { id to it } }.toMap()

    fun putAll(entries: Map<ID, V>) = entries.forEach { (id, value) -> cache.put(id, value) }
}
```

### 6. ValkeyRemoteCache.kt — L2 Valkey 원격 캐시
```kotlin
package com.cowave.search.repository.cache.tiered

import com.cowave.shared.utils.logger
import org.springframework.data.redis.core.RedisTemplate
import java.time.Duration

class ValkeyRemoteCache<ID : Any, V : Any>(
    private val redisTemplate: RedisTemplate<String, String>,
    private val serializer: CacheSerializer<V>,
    private val keyPrefix: String,
    private val ttl: Duration,
) {
    companion object {
        private val log by logger()
    }

    fun getAll(ids: List<ID>): Map<ID, V> {
        if (ids.isEmpty()) return emptyMap()
        return runCatching {
            val keys = ids.map { "$keyPrefix:$it" }
            val values = redisTemplate.opsForValue().multiGet(keys) ?: return emptyMap()
            ids.zip(values)
                .filter { (_, v) -> v != null }
                .associate { (id, json) -> id to serializer.deserialize(json!!) }
        }.onFailure { e ->
            log.warn(e) { "Valkey multiGet failed for prefix=$keyPrefix, falling back" }
        }.getOrDefault(emptyMap())
    }

    fun putAll(entries: Map<ID, V>) {
        if (entries.isEmpty()) return
        runCatching {
            redisTemplate.executePipelined { connection ->
                val stringSerializer = redisTemplate.stringSerializer
                entries.forEach { (id, value) ->
                    val key = stringSerializer.serialize("$keyPrefix:$id")!!
                    val json = stringSerializer.serialize(serializer.serialize(value))!!
                    connection.stringCommands().setEx(key, ttl.seconds, json)
                }
                null
            }
        }.onFailure { e ->
            log.warn(e) { "Valkey putAll failed for prefix=$keyPrefix, continuing" }
        }
    }
}
```

### 7. TieredCacheImpl.kt — L1→L2→fetcher 3단계 조회 구현체
```kotlin
package com.cowave.search.repository.cache.tiered

import com.cowave.shared.utils.logger

class TieredCacheImpl<ID : Any, V : Any>(
    private val l1: CaffeineLocalCache<ID, V>,
    private val l2: ValkeyRemoteCache<ID, V>,
    private val idExtractor: (V) -> ID,
) : TieredCache<ID, V> {
    companion object {
        private val log by logger()
    }

    override fun getOrFetch(ids: List<ID>, fetcher: (List<ID>) -> List<V>): List<V> {
        if (ids.isEmpty()) return emptyList()

        val uniqueIds = ids.distinct()

        // Step 1: L1 조회
        val l1Hits = l1.getAll(uniqueIds)
        val afterL1 = uniqueIds - l1Hits.keys
        log.debug { "TieredCache L1: hits=${l1Hits.size}, misses=${afterL1.size}" }

        // Step 2: L2 조회
        val l2Hits = if (afterL1.isNotEmpty()) l2.getAll(afterL1) else emptyMap()
        val afterL2 = afterL1 - l2Hits.keys
        if (l2Hits.isNotEmpty()) {
            l1.putAll(l2Hits)
            log.debug { "TieredCache L2: hits=${l2Hits.size}, misses=${afterL2.size}" }
        }

        // Step 3: API 호출
        val fetched = if (afterL2.isNotEmpty()) {
            val results = fetcher(afterL2)
            val mapped = results.associateBy(idExtractor)
            l1.putAll(mapped)
            l2.putAll(mapped)
            log.debug { "TieredCache Fetch: requested=${afterL2.size}, returned=${results.size}" }
            mapped
        } else {
            emptyMap()
        }

        val combined = l1Hits + l2Hits + fetched
        return ids.mapNotNull { combined[it] }
    }
}
```
